title: Ryan Gosling Joins MCU as Ghost Rider
summary: Ryan Gosling has been cast as the new Ghost Rider in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The film, directed by Shawn Levy, is set for release in 2028. The news was confirmed by Mathrubhumi English and reported on by The Telegraph India and The Times of India.
summary_points: Ryan Gosling has been cast as the new Ghost Rider
The film, directed by Shawn Levy, is set for release in 2028
The Telegraph India and The Times of India reported on the story

framing.left: Left-leaning outlets framed the story as a Hollywood news item, focusing on Ryan Gosling's casting and the film's release date.
framing.center: Centrist coverage reported the news without a distinct frame, simply stating that Ryan Gosling has been cast as the new Ghost Rider and the film is set for release in 2028.

framing_hi.left: लेफ्ट-वेंडिंग समाचारों ने इस कहानी को हॉलीवुड समाचार के रूप में फ्रेम किया, रyan गोसलिंग कasting और 2028 में रिलीज़ होने वाली फिल्म पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया।
framing_hi.center: केंद्रीय समाचार ने इस कहानी को एक विशिष्ट फ्रेम नहीं दिया, बस यह बताया कि रyan गोसलिंग नए गस्ट राइडर के रूप में चुने गए हैं और 2028 में रिलीज़ होने वाली फिल्म है।
